verdict.rationale: Replit's own docs say you can invite teammates to a project and build together, with each person starting their own Agent threads while working on the same project. Workspace-level admin controls and shared connectors support the team-workspace part of the story. missing for 10: details on real-time co-editing or multiplayer presence, roles and permissions for project collaborators, and independent or hands-on corroboration of team collaboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my team can work on the same project together in a shared workspace

citations.quote: Invite teammates to your project and build together — each person can start new threads with Agent while working on the same project.
Centralized management: Admin sets up a service once; builders use it across apps in that workspace.
